scope: Cutover rollback drill evidence for shadow read rollback, small-scope read rollback, dual-write disable plan, full read switch rollback, old write resume plan, and app Mongo archive/freeze rollback constraints.

rollback_point.postgresql_after_fact_source_constraint: old Mongo full overwrite of PostgreSQL is prohibited after PostgreSQL becomes the fact source

latest_app_mongo_backup_confirmation.reason: Existing backup/restore evidence is valid, but no approved cutover-window app Mongo freeze-point backup was created or confirmed for this drill.

drill_steps.rollback_point: shadow_read_enabled=false with user traffic still served by old Python API
drill_steps.expected_result: Shadow read can be disabled without user-visible route changes and without writing business facts.
drill_steps.actual_result: Not executed because no approved staging or production cutover drill window was provided.

drill_steps.rollback_point: route_group returned from Axum to old Python for a low-risk read scope
drill_steps.expected_result: Low-risk read traffic can return to old Python while PostgreSQL data is preserved for diagnosis.
drill_steps.actual_result: Not executed because no route control snapshot, traffic scope, or named rollback owner was approved.

drill_steps.rollback_point: dual_write_enabled=false before PostgreSQL is accepted as sole fact source
drill_steps.expected_result: Dual-write can be disabled, differences can be frozen for investigation, and no business facts are deleted.
drill_steps.actual_result: Not executed because dual-write was not enabled by this task and no staging replay evidence was provided.

drill_steps.rollback_point: all migrated read route groups returned from Axum to old Python
drill_steps.expected_result: Full read switch can be rolled back by route configuration only, with PostgreSQL retained and app Mongo untouched.
drill_steps.actual_result: Not executed because no approved full-read switch drill or route snapshot exists.

drill_steps.rollback_point: old write path resumes only before PostgreSQL is declared sole fact source
drill_steps.expected_result: Old write path can resume within the rollback window, with PostgreSQL differences compensated by audited scripts rather than destructive overwrite.
drill_steps.actual_result: Not executed because no approved write rollback drill or business acceptance window exists.

drill_steps.rollback_point: app Mongo remains retained as archive and rollback reference; it is not deleted
drill_steps.expected_result: Freeze/archive constraints are confirmed, no app Mongo deletion occurs, and old Mongo never overwrites PostgreSQL after PostgreSQL becomes fact source.
drill_steps.actual_result: Not executed because app Mongo freeze was not authorized and no freeze-point backup was created.
